activity_summary: You said afterward that the sermon had reached fourteenthly while you were still on the messenger. You left the half-line empty on purpose. You were well, and you said the nose was clear. The cold has not begun.

entities.name: Master Josias Thwaite
entities.context: Named as the man who reached fourteenthly. Not present.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The half-line is empty. I will not fill it tonight to be done.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I am well. The nose is clear.
